definitions.explanation: A port or harbor primarily used by fishing boats for landing catches, docking, and related operations. Japan has hundreds of fishing ports along its coastline.

examples.english: The fishing port is lively in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{漁港|ぎょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: You can buy fresh fish directly at this fishing port.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{漁港|ぎょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because a typhoon is approaching, all the boats in the fishing port have been tied down with ropes.

notes:
Composed of {漁|ぎょ} (fishing) + {港|こう} (port, harbor). A straightforward compound referring to ports whose primary function is commercial fishing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漁港|ぎょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝市|あさいち}→朝市：13008_asaichi⟧ (fishing port morning market)
- {漁港|ぎょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水揚|みずあ}げ→水揚げ：18504_mizuage⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to land a catch at the fishing port)
- {漁港|ぎょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ (fishing port restaurant)
- {漁港|ぎょこう}⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧ (around the fishing port)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧ — port, harbor; general term for any port
- ⟦{港湾|こうわん}→港湾：14767_kouwan⟧ — harbor, port facilities; more technical and administrative
- ⟦{船着|ふなつ}き{場|ば}→船着き場：21296_funatsukiba⟧ — landing place, dock; smaller and less formal

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese {漁港|ぎょこう} are popular tourist destinations. Many have ⟦{朝市|あさいち}→朝市：13008_asaichi⟧ (morning markets) and ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ (restaurants) where visitors can eat ultra-fresh seafood. Famous fishing ports include {焼津|やいづ} (Yaizu), {銚子|ちょうし} (Choshi), and {境港|さかいみなと} (Sakaiminato).
